verdict.rationale: Fastmail's JMAP API is built on an open, formally standardized protocol (RFC 8620/8621) with self-describing session/capability discovery (/.well-known/jmap and the session object listing capabilities and API URLs), which functions as a machine-readable API description that any agent could parse — confirmed live by runtime probes. However, there is no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file or similar single machine-readable spec artifact; explicit probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all returned 404. Missing for 10: an actual OpenAPI/Swagger (or JSON Schema) spec file, and any first-party statement equating the JMAP RFC/session discovery to an 'OpenAPI equivalent' for AI agents.
